question: The average age of 35 students in a group is 15 years. When the teacher's age is included, the average age of the group increases by 1.25 years. What is the teacher's age (in years)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Teacher's Age = Old Average + (New Total Members × Increase in Average)

Teacher's Age = 15 + (36 × 1.25)

Teacher's Age = 15 + 45 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Students = 35, Average age = 15 years

New average increase when teacher joins = 1.25 years

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Average Age × Number of Persons

 Net Deviation Method
 
 
 Old Avg = 15

 
 Extra = 36 × 1.25 = 45

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Teacher's Age = 15 + 45 = 60

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 35 students = 35 × 15 = 525 years

⇒ Total members including teacher = 35 + 1 = 36

⇒ New average age = 15 + 1.25 = 16.25 years

⇒ Total age of 36 members = 36 × 16.25 = 585 years

⇒ Teacher's age = Total age of 36 members − Total age of 35 students

⇒ Teacher's age = 585 − 525 = 60 years

**∴ The correct answer is 60 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Deviation Method for Averages

When a new entity joins a group and the average increases: New Value = Old Average + (Total Members × Increase in Average). This works seamlessly to avoid large multiplications.

Combined Average

The combined average of two distinct groups can be found using the formula: (N₁A₁ + N₂A₂) ÷ (N₁ + N₂), where N represents the number of items and A denotes the average of the respective groups.

Replacement Concept in Averages

If an existing member is replaced by a new person: New Person's Value = Replaced Person's Value + (Total Members × Change in Average).
